recipes.name: Fizzy Soda
recipes.desc: Fizz Syrup and ice, poured to the line. It burps politely when you open the lid, which is more than most customers do.
steps: Drop ING_ICE into the cup (6 cubes).
Hold to fill ING_SODA_SYRUP with fizz water to the 90–100 % band.
cx: It's flat. Like my personality, according to my mum.
Too much ice. I'm drinking a glacier.
recipes.look: Tall striped cup with a domed lid, bubbles visibly rising, a bendy straw.
recipes.anim: Cup burps a bubble out of the straw when picked up (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Rising bubble particles; a tiny 'burp!' text.
recipes.mut: A Peace Offering staple. Sweet Tooth speeds the pour; agitating it changes its drink mood (§5.4.8) for §6.18 mods.

recipes.name: Lemonade
recipes.desc: Hand-squeezed lemons, sugar and ice. Left to rest without stirring, it becomes a SAD lemonade and quietly sheds a single bubble-tear.
steps: Squeeze and stir by hand: ING_LEMON, then ING_SUGAR.
Pour the ING_LEMON mix with ING_SUGAR over ING_ICE and top with water to the line.
cx: Too sour! My face folded in half.
Too sweet! My teeth are filing a complaint.
recipes.look: Pale-yellow glass with lemon wheels, ice cubes and a striped paper straw.
recipes.anim: Customer puckers dramatically on the first sip (face morph).
recipes.vfx: Small citrus sparkle; SAD mood shows a bubble-tear (§5.4.8).
recipes.mut: Contains `ING_LEMON` + `ING_ICE`, so it can reach the SAD mood if rested (§5.4.8); plant parts speed the lemon chop.

recipes.name: Chocolate Milkshake
recipes.desc: Two scoops of ice cream, milk and chopped chocolate blended thick enough to stand a straw upright. The straw has never been prouder.
steps: Two scoops of ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE into the blender jar.
Blend ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE, ING_MILK and ING_CHOCOLATE to the smooth band.
cx: The straw fell over. That means it's not thick enough.
Too thick. I've been sucking for a minute and nothing's happened.
recipes.look: Tall glass of thick brown shake with chocolate flecks and a straw standing perfectly upright.
recipes.anim: Customer's cheeks cave in on the first sip (face morph) — classic thick-shake gag.
recipes.mut: Spark Blend (`MUT_081` Lightning Eyes, `MUT_253` Electric Eel Skin) speeds the blend; Sweet Tooth on the scoop.

recipes.name: Strawberry Smoothie
recipes.desc: Strawberries, banana, yogurt and ice blended pink and frothy. The Health Nut Hamster drinks four a day and vibrates slightly.
steps: Blend ING_STRAWBERRY, ING_BANANA, ING_YOGURT and ING_ICE.
Pour the ING_STRAWBERRY smoothie into the cup and add a berry on the rim.
cx: Lumpy. A smoothie should be SMOOTH. It's in the name.
Too pink. I asked for 'blush', not 'flamingo'.
recipes.look: Frothy pink smoothie in a clear cup with a strawberry on the rim.
recipes.anim: Froth fizzes up when the straw goes in (prop tween).
recipes.mut: Spark Blend speeds the blend; plant parts widen the strawberry chop zone.

recipes.name: Bubble Tea
recipes.desc: Sweet milk tea over chewy tapioca pearls that bounce up the fat straw like tiny happy basketballs.
steps: Brew ING_TEA on the second burner.
Pour ING_TEA with ING_MILK, ING_SUGAR and ING_ICE; shake gently.
Cup: ING_TAPIOCA pearls first, then the ING_TEA milk tea; seal and add the fat straw.
cx: A pearl got stuck in the straw. We're both trapped now.
Not enough pearls. I count fifteen. FIFTEEN.
recipes.look: Sealed cup of beige milk tea with black pearls at the bottom and a fat striped straw.
recipes.anim: Pearls zoom up the straw on each sip (prop tween).
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs both burners; Sticky Grip prevents spilled pearls; Sweet Tooth on the pour.

recipes.name: Rainbow Slushie
recipes.desc: Fizzy slush with Rainbow Syrup poured in seven perfect bands. Drink it fast and you get a rainbow brain-freeze.
steps: Blend ING_ICE with ING_SODA_SYRUP into slush.
Layer ING_RAINBOW_SYRUP in seven bands as you fill (hold steady).
cx: The bands blurred. It's a sunset now, not a rainbow.
My brain froze in only ONE colour.
recipes.look: Clear dome cup showing seven distinct colour bands of slush.
recipes.anim: Customer clutches head in a cartoon brain-freeze (ANM_047 Complain variant, no anger).
recipes.mut: Cold-tagged chefs (`MUT_131` Fridge Body) and Sweet Tooth speed the pour; Spark Blend speeds the slush.

recipes.name: Angry Coffee
recipes.desc: Ground-to-order beans, steamed milk, a splash of hot sauce and some chocolate — then agitated until it is genuinely furious. It glares at you from the cup.
steps: Combine coffee with ING_SUGAR and ING_HOT_SAUCE, then Agitate to 70–95 for the ANGRY mood.
recipes.sat: Served ANGRY by default (§5.4.8); if a ticket mod asks for another mood, the mod wins
cx: It's not angry. It's mildly irritated at best.
It yelled at me. I asked for angry, not abusive!
recipes.look: Dark mug with red foam, angry cartoon eyebrows drawn in the foam and a steam plume.
recipes.anim: Foam eyebrows furrow and the mug rattles on the saucer (prop shake).
recipes.vfx: Steam puffs shaped like little storm clouds (no flames).
recipes.mut: `MUT_081` Lightning Eyes chefs (electric) blend faster; Steam Team on the brew and steam; agitating parts with `loud` make it louder (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Swamp Water Smoothie
recipes.desc: Spinach, apple, banana and slime jelly blended swamp-green, with gummy-worm ribbons swirled through. Tastes like a fruit salad wearing camouflage.
steps: Blend ING_SPINACH, ING_SLIME_JELLY, ING_BANANA, ING_APPLE and ING_YOGURT.
Swamp ribbons: ING_SLIME_JELLY swirl, then ING_GUMMY_WORM bits.
Cup of ING_SPINACH smoothie with an ING_GUMMY_WORM hanging over the rim.
cx: It's not swampy enough. I want to see a frog.
There's a worm on my cup. A candy worm. I'm fine. I'm FINE.
recipes.look: Murky green smoothie with jelly ribbons and a gummy worm draped over the rim.
recipes.anim: Gummy worm wriggles on the rim (prop bones).
recipes.mut: `MUT_005` Frog Head and `MUT_061` Frog Tongue customers try to snatch the worm (bark); Spark Blend speeds both blend and mix.

recipes.name: Ice Ice Smoothie
recipes.desc: Mango, watermelon and yogurt blended with twelve ice cubes and crowned with a frozen ice-cream crown. So cold it hums a song about itself.
steps: Blend ING_ICE, ING_MANGO, ING_WATERMELON and ING_YOGURT.
Freeze ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE into a crown mould (6 s).
Cup of ING_ICE smoothie, ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE crown on top.
cx: It's only ice. I wanted ice ICE.
Too cold. My tongue is skating.
recipes.look: Frosted orange-pink smoothie with an icy crown of frozen cream and frost crystals on the cup.
recipes.anim: Cup hums a tiny tune (audio) and frosts the table where it stands (decal).
recipes.mut: Cold Snap / `ABL_067` Freeze Touch handles the crown instantly; `MUT_162` Ice Crystal Arm chefs get a 'brrr-illiant' bark.

recipes.name: Hot Sauce Latte
recipes.desc: Espresso, steamed milk and a cinnamon hot-sauce syrup, topped with a single floating Lava Pepper ring. Wakes you up and then politely sets your eyebrows to 'surprised'.
steps: Mug: ING_COFFEE_BEANS espresso, ING_HOT_SAUCE syrup, ING_MILK foam, ING_LAVA_PEPPER ring floating.
cx: My eyebrows stayed where they were. Not spicy.
Latte art should be a heart, not a flame emoji.
recipes.look: Tall mug with red-tinted foam, latte art shaped like a little flame and a red pepper ring floating.
recipes.anim: Customer's eyebrows shoot up after the first sip (face morph); steam ears.
recipes.vfx: Cartoon steam puffs and warm orange shimmer.
recipes.mut: Steam Team on the brew and steam; Hot Hands has no heat step here, but `fire` customers (`MUT_273` Flame Aura) tip with a wink (bark).

recipes.name: Tentacle Tea
recipes.desc: Milk tea steeped with a squishy tentacle stirrer and tapioca pearls. The tentacle stirs for you. Politely. Clockwise.
steps: Steep ING_TEA with ING_TENTACLE in the pot.
Boil ING_TAPIOCA on the other burner.
Top with ING_MILK and ING_SUGAR to the line.
Cup: ING_TAPIOCA, ING_TEA, ING_TENTACLE stirrer curled over the rim.
cx: It stirred anti-clockwise. That's how you summon things.
The tentacle stopped stirring. Is it on break?
recipes.look: Milk tea with pearls and a purple tentacle curling up out of the cup, tip gently stirring.
recipes.anim: Tentacle stirs in slow clockwise circles (prop bones loop).
recipes.vfx: Tiny bubble rings from the stirring.
recipes.mut: Tentacle parts give a 'cousin' bark; Sea Legs on the steep; `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs both burners.

recipes.name: Volcano Float
recipes.desc: Fizzy soda with an ice-cream iceberg, then Lava Sauce poured over until it 'erupts' in harmless red fizz. Do not shake. Do NOT shake.
steps: Pour ING_ICE and ING_SODA_SYRUP fizz to 90 %.
Float one scoop of ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE on top.
Drizzle ING_LAVA_SAUCE over the scoop until it erupts.
Cup: ING_ICE, ING_SODA_SYRUP, ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE, ING_LAVA_SAUCE; add a long spoon.
cx: It didn't erupt. Dormant float. Zero stars.
It erupted onto my lap. Five stars.
recipes.look: Tall glass of fizzing soda with a white scoop 'island' and glowing red sauce lava dripping down it.
recipes.anim: Red foam bubbles over the rim once on serve (texture + mesh), then settles.
recipes.vfx: Red fizz eruption particles (kid-safe), orange glow; agitating it risks the EXPLODED mood (§5.4.8).
recipes.mut: Sweet Tooth on the pours and scoop; `MUT_034` Lava Rock Head customers order two (bark).

recipes.name: Glowing Mutagen Juice
recipes.desc: Lime-flavoured Mutagen Goo blended with apple, lemon and ice into a neon juice that glows in the dark. It does not mutate you. It just makes your teeth glow for a minute.
steps: Blend ING_MUTAGEN_GOO, ING_LEMON, ING_APPLE, ING_ICE and ING_SUGAR (lid tight!).
Pour the ING_MUTAGEN_GOO juice into the beaker cup.
Seal with a glowing straw lid.
recipes.sat: Not Mutation Cuisine: no cosmetic part and no Whoa! bonus — customers sometimes complain about exactly that
cx: I didn't grow a single tentacle. False advertising!
It's glowing at the wrong frequency.
recipes.look: Neon-green juice in a lab-beaker cup that glows, bubbles rising, a radioactive-free smiley sticker.
recipes.anim: Customer's teeth glow green for 5 s after drinking (face texture swap).
recipes.vfx: Green PointLight glow and bubbles (Reduced Effects: emissive only).
recipes.mut: Glow Guide and Space Chef-adjacent parts love it; it teases Mutation Cuisine (`MUT_134` Slime Body customers ask 'is this the good stuff?').

recipes.name: Cloud Juice
recipes.desc: Two Cloud Fluffs blended with milk, blueberries and ice into a drink so light it floats a little cloud cap above the cup. Hold on to the cup. Firmly.
steps: Blend ING_MILK, ING_ICE and ING_BLUEBERRY into the base.
Frost the cup (5 s) so the cloud sticks.
Cup: ING_MILK juice base, ING_CLOUD_FLUFF cap floating above.
Tether the cloud with a paper umbrella.
cx: My cloud drifted to the next table. Get it back.
It's a cirrus. I ordered cumulus.
recipes.look: Pale-lavender drink with a fluffy white cloud hovering 0.3 studs above the cup, tethered by a paper umbrella.
recipes.anim: Cloud bobs and occasionally drizzles a few sparkly drops into the cup.
recipes.vfx: Soft cloud puffs and sugar-rain sparkles.
recipes.mut: `MUT_197` Cloud Leg chefs earn a 'family reunion' bark; Spark Blend on both blends.

recipes.name: Liquid Lightning
recipes.desc: Lightning Soda charged in the Mutagen Infuser and poured over a blueberry storm syrup. It crackles, it sparks, it gives Sleepy Sloth-Rockets the zoomies for ten whole seconds.
steps: Cut ING_LEMON into a lightning-bolt twist.
Storm syrup: blend ING_BLUEBERRY with ING_SUGAR.
Charge ING_LIGHTNING_SODA; hold pressure 50–75 until it crackles.
Pour ING_ICE, then the charged ING_LIGHTNING_SODA over the syrup.
Cup: ING_ICE, ING_BLUEBERRY storm syrup, ING_LIGHTNING_SODA, ING_LEMON bolt garnish.
Insulated lid — it zaps the straw otherwise.
cx: It only sparked twice. I wanted a thunderstorm.
My fur is standing up. ALL of it.
recipes.look: Electric-yellow drink with a purple storm layer at the bottom, tiny arcs of light crackling across the surface.
recipes.anim: Customer's hair/fur/feathers stand on end for 3 s (puff morph) and they zip around the seat (ANM_003 Run in place, comedic).
recipes.vfx: Small cartoon spark arcs and zig-zag light (Reduced Effects: static bolt decal, no flashing).
recipes.mut: Space Chef (`alien`/`cosmic` parts) widens the INFUSE window; electric parts (`MUT_159` Electric Eel Arm, `MUT_230` Lightning Tail) crackle in harmony with it (bark).
